title: A Must Have Spare Part To Have On Hand!
text: A Must Have Spare Part To Have On Hand!. It’s nice to get so many of these for such a great price. The silicone seal does wear out overtime from all the heat and pressure in the cooker so it’s good to have some spares around. You might also lose one when you’re washing the lid just like I did! 😂

product_metadata.title: 10 Pack Universal Replacement Floater and Sealer for Pressure Cookers Such as XL, YBD60-100, PPC780, PPC770, and PPC790
features: Floater and sealer set size：19mm*9mm and 12mm*3mm,Sealer Made from 100% Safe Food-Grade durable Silicone ,Odor Resistant.
Floater and sealer are part of the lid of Power Pressure Cooker, and are essential for pressure cooker to work
The sealer is often washed off, leaving the floater loose and the pressure cooker unusable，This floater and sealer set fits the lids of almost all pressure cooker universally
This floater and sealer set fits many models of the Power Pressure Cookers including but not limiting to XL (6 & 8 quarts), YBD60-100, PPC780, PPC770, and PPC790
Please check the pictures to see the sizes of the set before buying
description: Feature: Floater Made of Stainless steel , Floater size：19mm*9mm(0.75*0.28inch) Sealer Made from 100% Safe Food-Grade durable Silicone ,Odor Resistant, Sealer set size: 12mm*3mm(0.47*0.12inch) Package Inclued: 10* Floater 10*Sealer NOTE: This floater and sealer set fits many models of the Power Pressure Cookers including but not limiting to XL (6 & 8 quarts), YBD60-100, PPC780, PPC770, and PPC790
